responsibility: This file provides the out-of-line C++ convenience implementation around libiberty’s `pex` subprocess-execution API. It adds helpers to read an entire `FILE *` stream into a `std::vector<char>` and implements the `pex::run` overload that accepts a `std::vector<std::string>` by converting it to the `char * const *` argv form expected by `pex_run`. Its role is the small host-side adapter layer that makes process execution and captured I/O easier to use from modern GCC C++ code.
same_name_distinction: Implements the out-of-line behavior declared in `pex.h`: the stream-reading helper and the `pex::run` overload that accepts `std::vector<std::string>` and marshals it to the low-level `char * const *` `pex_run` interface. Unlike `pex.h`, it is not the RAII API definition but the small adapter implementation.
